obligation: SOC 2 CC6.1 Logical access security (SOC 2-aligned control)
finshield_control: Cognito sign-in with 5 groups; private KMS-encrypted KYC bucket; images opened only through API-issued presigned URLs; KMS key usable only inside the account via DynamoDB and S3.
evidence: Cognito group membership; KYC bucket policy and public access block; API access logs

obligation: SOC 2 CC6.2 Registering and removing users (SOC 2-aligned control)
finshield_control: Users are created by an admin only (no self sign-up); a confirmed incident ends with the account LOCKED after SecurityHead approval.
evidence: Cognito admin-create setting; LOCKED status and decision entry in the evidence chain

obligation: SOC 2 CC6.3 Role-based access, least privilege (SOC 2-aligned control)
finshield_control: Group-based API permissions (Auditor read-only, only SecurityHead and ComplianceHead can approve a lock, only SecurityHead can release); per-Lambda IAM roles; nobody can update or delete evidence.
evidence: API group checks; IAM policies in infra/template.yaml

obligation: SOC 2 CC7.2 Monitoring for anomalies (SOC 2-aligned control)
finshield_control: Detection scores every normalised event against per-user baselines (rules S1 to S11 in contract/config.json): bulk KYC downloads, off-hours, new device or city, emergency role, external upload, MFA fatigue, logging changes.
evidence: Alert with score split by signal; event timeline

obligation: SOC 2 CC7.3 Evaluating security events (SOC 2-aligned control)
finshield_control: Code computes the score and severity (Critical 80+, High 60-79, Medium 40-59, below 40 logged only); approved jobs and tickets cap the score (E1 to E3); one open alert per user per 60 minutes; AI explains the decision in words only.
evidence: Alert severity, signals and AI card; Accuracy panel (0 false alerts on normal days)

obligation: SOC 2 CC7.4 Incident response (SOC 2-aligned control)
finshield_control: Step Functions incident workflow: automatic reversible containment (revoke sessions, deactivate keys, bucket deny), SNS notice, SecurityHead approval to lock, release to undo, regulator deadline timers and report drafts.
evidence: Containment status; decision record; RBI, CERT-In and DPB report drafts

obligation: SOC 2 CC8.1 Change management (SOC 2-aligned control)
finshield_control: All infrastructure is code (one SAM template); contract changes go through contract/CHANGES.md; tests must pass before every push. FinShield also flags unauthorised changes: logging switched off (S8) and resources marked non-compliant by AWS Config (S11).
evidence: Git history and test runs; LOGGING_CHANGE and CONFIG_NONCOMPLIANT alerts

obligation: SOC 2 C1.1 Identifying confidential information (SOC 2-aligned control)
finshield_control: KYC data is marked as data class KYC on every event; each KYC file has a document type and AI label in KycFiles; images are tagged sample=true; tables keep only Aadhaar last 4 and a fake PAN.
evidence: KycFiles records; S3 object tags; data-handling.md

obligation: ISO 27001:2022 A.5.15 Access control (ISO 27001-aligned control)
finshield_control: Access rules are defined per Cognito group in the API spec and per function in IAM; the KYC bucket is private and opened only through the API.

obligation: ISO 27001:2022 A.8.2 Privileged access rights (ISO 27001-aligned control)
finshield_control: Privileged users and emergency-role use are scored higher (S3); privileged sessions are revoked and keys deactivated on a Critical alert; the lock needs SecurityHead approval.

obligation: ISO 27001:2022 A.8.12 Data leakage prevention (ISO 27001-aligned control)
finshield_control: Bulk KYC download (S1) and upload to an outside destination (S4) raise an alert; containment adds a deny on the KYC bucket for that user; unapproved destinations are recorded.
evidence: SC-01 alert (score 96); bucket deny statement FinShieldDeny<user>

obligation: ISO 27001:2022 A.8.15 Logging (ISO 27001-aligned control)
finshield_control: CloudTrail with log-file validation and S3 data events on the KYC bucket; raw events kept 1 year; every alert step written to the hash-chained evidence log. Retention note: CloudTrail 90 days, Step Functions logs 14 days (see data-handling.md, known gaps).
evidence: Trail bucket; raw-events bucket; evidence chain

obligation: ISO 27001:2022 A.8.16 Monitoring activities (ISO 27001-aligned control)
finshield_control: CloudTrail, GuardDuty and AWS Config events are forwarded to the FinShield bus, normalised and scored against baselines in near real time.

obligation: ISO 27001:2022 A.5.24 Incident management planning and preparation (ISO 27001-aligned control)
finshield_control: The incident workflow, severity bands, containment steps and approver roles are defined in advance in contract/config.json and the state machine; the demo is rehearsed against 11 scenarios.

obligation: ISO 27001:2022 A.5.25 Assessment and decision on events (ISO 27001-aligned control)
finshield_control: Deterministic scoring decides the severity; below 40 is logged only; approved jobs and tickets cap the score; the AI card explains the facts.
evidence: Alert score bar and signals; Accuracy panel

obligation: ISO 27001:2022 A.5.26 Response to incidents (ISO 27001-aligned control)
finshield_control: Documented Step Functions workflow: contain, notify, approve, lock or release; status moves OPEN to CONTAINED to AWAITING_APPROVAL to LOCKED or RELEASED.

obligation: ISO 27001:2022 A.5.28 Collection of evidence (ISO 27001-aligned control)
finshield_control: Every step is appended to a SHA-256 hash chain (append-only table, no update or delete rights) and exported to an S3 Object Lock bucket for 1 year; Verify and a tamper demo prove integrity.
evidence: Evidence chain with Verify result; Object Lock export

obligation: ISO 27001:2022 A.5.34 Privacy and protection of PII (ISO 27001-aligned control)
finshield_control: Only Aadhaar last 4 and a fake PAN are stored; Bedrock Guardrail masks names, Aadhaar and PAN in AI text; consent ledger flags purpose mismatches (S9); KYC labelling flags images that show a full Aadhaar number. Presented as DPDP-aligned readiness and controls.
evidence: Privacy view: consent risks, unmasked Aadhaar files

obligation: ISO 27001:2022 A.8.24 Use of cryptography (ISO 27001-aligned control)
finshield_control: Customer-managed KMS key with automatic rotation encrypts all tables and the KYC bucket; evidence bucket uses SSE-S3; SHA-256 hash chain for evidence; TLS on all AWS API calls.
evidence: KMS key settings; bucket encryption settings
